en.headline: Bug report on openchamber turn-merging; 19 automated commits
en.summary: On 2026-10-10, activity centered on a single bug report in `openchamber/openchamber`. The user opened issue #4664, titled "[Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity", at 06:48 UTC, then followed up with a comment at 07:01 UTC. About eight minutes after the report was filed, `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied with a maintainer note tagged `fix-ready`, tracing the cause to two pieces on current `main` — grouping logic in `packages/ui/src/components/chat/lib/turns/projectTurnRecords.ts:244-246` and a related mechanism — confirming the behavior on the current branch. No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or discussions were recorded for the day. The user's own commit count was **0**, with 19 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`; no commit messages were provided for those automated entries.
